nodes.label: EVA: Empathetic LLMs with Emotional Validation
nodes.rationale: Proposes training method for empathetic response generation grounded in emotional validation theory from DBT; includes two-stage training (empathy acquisition and emotional validation alignment).

nodes.label: Emotional Validation Theory
nodes.rationale: Four-level hierarchical framework from DBT (Linehan, 1997): LEVEL 1 (Listening and Observing), LEVEL 2 (Accurate Reflection), LEVEL 3 (Validating), LEVEL 4 (Radical Genuineness).

nodes.label: Emotional Validation Aware Dataset (EVAD)
nodes.rationale: Human preference dataset annotated with emotional validation levels; constructed by prompting ChatGPT to generate utterances at each level, then filtered and ranked by human annotators.

nodes.label: EVAEval Metric
nodes.rationale: Novel evaluation metric assessing whether model-generated responses align with emotional validation theory by measuring distribution of emotional levels across dialogue quartiles.

nodes.label: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
nodes.rationale: Training approach aligning model outputs with human preferences by training on pairs of preferred and rejected responses (Rafailov et al., 2024).

nodes.label: ESConv Dataset
nodes.rationale: Emotional Support Conversation dataset with trained crowdworkers as supporters and real/simulated help-seekers; ensures balanced gender representation and high authenticity (Liu et al., 2021).

nodes.label: EmpathieticDialogues Dataset
nodes.rationale: Crowdsourced empathetic conversation dataset from US-based MTurk workers with diverse personal experiences (Rashkin et al., 2019).

nodes.label: EPITOME Framework
nodes.rationale: RoBERTa-based framework measuring empathy through three dimensions: Interpretations (IP), Explorations (EX), and Emotional Reactions (ER) (Sharma et al., 2020).
